getComputedStyle returns oklch tokens as lab() in Chrome, which is useless in a style guide. Painting each colour into a 1x1 canvas and reading the pixel back normalises any notation to hex.

Frame at ~279:30 corrected ch13: his real style guide centres the heading, uses the subtitle "Manage your style guide for your project." and lowercase centred tabs (colours / typography / moodboard) - not the left-aligned Figma layout with right-side tabs. Updated to match.

His component path is src/components/style/mood-board/index.tsx and the hook is use-styles.ts, per the editor tabs in the frame.

Frame at ~376:40 gave ch17 structure: the hook is useInfiniteCanvas in src/hooks/use-canvas.ts (842 lines in his build), ZoomBar lives at src/components/canvas/toolbar/zoom/index.tsx, shapes use an RTK entity adapter (entityState.entities) and the viewport is { scale, translate }.

attachCanvasRef is a callback ref that adds the wheel listener with { passive: false } - React onWheel is always passive, so preventDefault would not work and the page would scroll instead of zooming.
The same frame captured a runtime error worth avoiding: calling useInfiniteCanvas from the canvas layout without use client fails with "Attempted to call useInfiniteCanvas() from the server".

Canvas collapsed to height 0 on first run: h-full cannot resolve a percentage against a flex-1 parent with no definite height. Absolute inset-0 fixes it. Caught by measuring the element rect rather than trusting the screenshot.

Ch18 toolbar read from a magnified frame crop at ~388:20: one centred bar holding select, hand, frame, rectangle, circle, pencil and arrow, with the zoom group nested inside the same bar as its own pill - not a separate control at the right edge as first built.
An svg sized 0x0 paints nothing even with overflow visible, and the transformed layer has no intrinsic size to inherit. Path shapes anchor their svg to the shape bounding box and draw relative to it.
Freehand needs its box computed from every sampled point. Deriving it from the start and the current cursor only clips the stroke into fragments, which is what happened on the first pencil render.

Frame at ~453:00 shows the FINAL canvas layout, which differs from ch18: undo/redo bottom-left, the nine tools centred (select, frame, rect, circle, pencil, arrow, line, text, eraser), and zoom moved back out to the bottom-right. Frames carry Inspiration and Generate pills above their top-right corner.

Undo appeared broken but was not: Next.js dev indicator (NEXTJS-PORTAL) sits in the bottom-left corner and swallowed the click. Confirmed with elementFromPoint, then offset the history cluster. Dev-only, but it makes the button unusable while developing.

Ch28 deviation: video has the model emit Tailwind classes. Tailwind v4 compiles classes it can see at build time, so runtime-invented classes have no rule. Model writes inline styles referencing CSS variables bound on the container instead.
Ch28 deviation: sanitiser is DOMParser + tree walk (src/lib/sanitise.ts), not regex. Allowlist of tags/attrs, strips on*, non-https/data:image URLs.
Ch28: stream updates use setGeneratedHtml which does NOT commit history — one snapshot per chunk would flush the 50-deep undo stack in seconds.
Ch28: credit is charged up front, before the stream opens — once bytes are flowing there is no clean way to fail the request.

Ch28: Google font loading moved to src/hooks/use-google-font.ts and called from GeneratedUI too; previously only the Typography tab loaded it, so designs on the canvas referenced a font that was never fetched.

Canvas fixes (user-reported): stroke shapes were unclickable (svg pointer-events-none) so the eraser could never hit them — added a transparent 14-wide hit stroke; selection cleared itself because the shape's pointerdown bubbled to the canvas handler — shapes now stopPropagation; added drag-to-move and corner-grip resize, with paths translated/scaled through the same transform.
Drag gestures snapshot history once at pointerdown then use updateShapeLive (no commit) — committing per pointermove would spend the whole 50-step history on one drag.
Ch29: convex/inspiration.ts + use-inspiration + InspirationSidebar; max 6 references per project; route sends them after the sketch.

Ch29 fix: the no-style-guide fallback in the generate route told the model to stay neutral, which cancelled out the reference images. Now it defers to the references when any are present. Verified greyscale-before / neon-after.
Ch30 next: Workflows Ai generation (42.7m). Ch31 chat, ch32 pre-deploy note, ch33 Sevalla deploy.

Text tool (user-reported): click-to-type now works. Three causes — setTool clears editingId and was dispatched after setEditingId; the draft shape lived only in React state so a click (no render between pointerdown/up) created nothing; beginMove stopped the event for every shape click before checking the tool, making the area over any shape dead for drawing.
Draft shape is mirrored in draftRef and updated synchronously via putDraft — React state alone is not safe to read in the pointerup of the same click.

Ch30 deviation: video hardcodes 4 page types and says on camera not to do it that way. Implemented his recommended version — /api/generate/workflow/plan asks the model to plan the flow from the source screen, then /api/generate/workflow streams each page.
Ch30: pages generated sequentially, 1 credit each; the plan route refuses up front unless the whole flow can be paid for.

REGRESSION FOUND in ch30 testing: beginMove calls setPointerCapture on the shape, and a captured pointer sends the following click to the capturing element — so the frame's Inspiration/Generate pills stopped firing after the canvas-manipulation commit. Controls on a shape now stopPropagation on pointerdown.
Testing note: pipe CDP scripts to a file, not through `tail` — node buffers stdout when piped and the output only appears at exit, which hides where a long run is stuck.

Ch29 under-implementation, found by comparing our output to the user's Dribbble reference: inspiration images were sent as vision input only, and the prompt banned external images — so designs came out as flat blocks with SVG placeholders. The hosted Convex URLs now go into the brief as text (src/lib/imagery-brief.ts) for both the design and workflow routes, with rules on where photography belongs. Verified: 4 imgs from 2 URLs, none broken.
credits:grant is an internalMutation for topping up while billing does not exist: npx convex run credits:grant '{"amount": 20}'. Applies to every user in the deployment.

Generated designs are now full shapes: draggable, selectable, resizable, deletable. The inner design is pointer-events-none so the wrapper receives the drag; auto-height is grow-only so it stops fighting a manual resize.

Model A/B on the same sketch + reference: claude-opus-5 = 13.4k markup in 65s; gpt-5.6-sol = 7.5k in 99s. Opus 5 kept. ANTHROPIC_UI_MODEL exists to switch the design model without touching the extraction model. Router serves only claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8, gpt-5.6-sol.

Images are downloaded server-side and sent as file parts (src/lib/fetch-image.ts). Passing URLs fails on non-Anthropic models behind the gateway ('expected a base64-encoded data URL ... malformed MIME type') and the old 'image' part is deprecated.
gpt-5.6-sol returns tool_use blocks with no id; the SDK rejects the whole message as Invalid JSON response. gatewayFetch in lib/anthropic.ts fills the id in.

Inspiration references are vision-only and must NEVER be embedded — they are screenshots of websites, and rendering one puts a website inside the website. Photographic slots use loremflickr with keyword + lock. source.unsplash.com is retired (503).

His sketches are ANNOTATED (labels like 'Image should take full height of this section', 'Add To Cart', '$49.99'). That is a large part of why his output looks intentional. Our text tool only started working recently — tell the user to label sketches.
